manual/component/3e45a5de5caae20b.html.title: 1. FmodPlayComponent 使用说明 Usage Guide | Panzer War Document
manual/component/3e45a5de5caae20b.html.keywords: 1. FmodPlayComponent 使用说明 Usage Guide 简介 Introduction FmodPlayComponent 是一个 MonoBehaviour 组件，用于异步加载并播放 FMOD 音效。通过关联 EventReference 和 PlayParams 实现播放指定 FMOD 事件及其参数的功能。 FmodPlayComponent is a MonoBehaviour component that asynchronously loads and plays FMOD sound effects. By linking an EventReference and PlayParams, it plays the specified FMOD event along with its parameters. 如何使用 How to Use 将 FmodPlayComponent 挂载到需要播放音效的 GameObject 上。 在 Inspector 面板中，找到 EventReference 属性，将需要播放的 FMOD 事件拖拽到该属性中。 在 Inspector 面板中，找到 PlayParams 属性，可以添加多个参数来控制播放效果。每个参数包含一个 key 和 value，其中 key 为 FMOD 事件中的参数名称，value 为设置的参数值。 Attach FmodPlayComponent to the GameObject that needs to play the sound effect. In the Inspector panel, find the EventReference property and drag the FMOD event you want to play onto it. In the Inspector panel, find the PlayParams property, where you can add multiple parameters to control playback. Each parameter consists of a key and a value: the key is the parameter name defined in the FMOD event, and the value is the value to set. 以上是 FmodPlayComponent 的使用说明，如有疑问，请查看官方文档或联系开发者。 This concludes the FmodPlayComponent usage guide. If you have any questions, please consult the official documentation or contact the developers.

manual/component/ba144e39cddbd72f.html.title: 2. VehicleTextData 使用说明 Usage Guide | Panzer War Document
manual/component/ba144e39cddbd72f.html.keywords: 2. VehicleTextData 使用说明 Usage Guide VehicleTextData 是一个用于配置载具（如坦克、机甲、汽车等）的各种参数的类。本文档将指导您如何在 Unity Inspector 界面上使用它。 VehicleTextData is a class used to configure the various parameters of a vehicle (such as a tank, mech, or car). This document explains how to use it in the Unity Inspector. 基础 Basics 玩家状态参数 (基础数据) Player State Parameters (Basic Data) PSParameter - 这个属性包含了玩家状态的基本参数。例如，生命值、国家、载具类型等。 PSParameter - This property contains the basic player state parameters, such as health, country, and vehicle type. 移动 Movement 履带参数 Track Parameters PTCParameter - 仅在载具使用履带时显示，此属性包含了履带控制器的参数。例如，坦克的动力，速度，负重轮参数，独立悬挂履带等。 PTCParameter - Shown only when the vehicle uses tracks. This property contains the track controller parameters, such as the tank's power, speed, road wheel parameters, and independently suspended tracks. 机甲参数 Mech Parameters MechParameter - 包含机甲控制器的参数。例如，机甲的转向速度，飞行参数等。 MechParameter - Contains the mech controller parameters, such as the mech's turning speed and flight parameters. 汽车参数 Car Parameters CarControllerParameter - 包含汽车控制器的参数。 CarControllerParameter - Contains the car controller parameters. 开火 Firing 共享主炮数据 Shared Main Gun Data SharedGunData - 此属性用于存储可以在多个载具之间共享的主炮数据。包括炮弹类型、射速、弹道、弹药容量等。 SharedGunData - This property stores main gun data that can be shared across multiple vehicles, including shell type, rate of fire, ballistics, and ammunition capacity. 主炮参数 Main Gun Parameters TFParameter - 当没有共享主炮数据时显示，此属性包含了主炮的参数。例如，射速、弹道、炮口初速、后坐力等。 TFParameter - Shown when there is no shared main gun data. This property contains the main gun parameters, such as rate of fire, ballistics, muzzle velocity, and recoil. 自爆参数 Self-Destruct Parameters VehicleSelfExplosionParams - 包含载具自爆功能的相关参数。例如，自爆范围、自爆伤害、自爆延迟等。 VehicleSelfExplosionParams - Contains the parameters for the vehicle self-destruct feature, such as blast radius, blast damage, and detonation delay. 炮塔 Turret 共享炮塔数据 Shared Turret Data SharedTurretData - 用于存储可以在多个载具之间共享的炮塔数据。包括炮塔旋转速度、炮管升降速度、最大仰角等。 SharedTurretData - Stores turret data that can be shared across multiple vehicles, including turret rotation speed, gun barrel elevation speed, and maximum elevation angle. 炮塔参数 Turret Parameters MTParameter - 当没有共享炮塔数据时显示，此属性包含了炮塔的参数。例如，炮塔旋转角度、炮管升降速度、最大俯角等。 MTParameter - Shown when there is no shared turret data. This property contains the turret parameters, such as turret rotation angle, gun barrel elevation speed, and maximum depression angle. 新多炮塔 New Multi-Turret 多炮塔数据 Multi-Turret Data MultiFireSystemData - 此属性包含了多炮塔系统的数据。例如，每个炮塔的炮弹类型、射速、弹道等。 MultiFireSystemData - Contains the data for the multi-turret system, such as the shell type, rate of fire, and ballistics of each turret. 简单多炮塔数据 Simple Multi-Turret Data SimpleVehicleFireSystemParameters - 此属性包含了简单多炮塔系统的参数。例如，炮塔旋转速度、炮管升降速度等。 SimpleVehicleFireSystemParameters - Contains the parameters for the simple multi-turret system, such as turret rotation speed and gun barrel elevation speed.

manual/gameplay/0336be5a9f2cd38b.html.title: 6. 地图编辑器使用教程 Map Editor Tutorial | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/0336be5a9f2cd38b.html.keywords: 6. 地图编辑器使用教程 Map Editor Tutorial 案例地图分享码： Share code of the example map: c564f128-6d1b-4db5-84a2-953b1de0d52c -[Map]-[simplemap] 地图制作注意事项 Notes on Making a Map 需要包含 Tag，TeamAStartPoint（A 队出生点），TeamBStartPoint （B 队出生点）应该相互有一定距离间隔 使用空气墙组件，拉伸模型，围住地图边缘 警惕 Z-Fighting 带来的抖动，模型请勿完全重叠，会导致模型来回闪烁。 The map must contain the tags TeamAStartPoint (Team A spawn point) and TeamBStartPoint (Team B spawn point), and they should be placed a certain distance apart from each other. Use the air wall component and stretch its model to enclose the edges of the map. Beware of the flickering caused by Z-Fighting. Do not let models overlap completely, otherwise they will flicker back and forth. 运行时可能遇到的问题 Possible Issues at Runtime 无法出生。 设置的 tag 太少或者距离过近。 远距离没看见自己摆放的小细节物体。由于优化原因，只有在工坊时候，才会显示所有物体，运行时会根据 lod 策略选择物体的细节等级 Unable to spawn. Too few tags were set, or they are placed too close to each other. Small detail objects you placed are not visible from a distance. For optimization reasons, all objects are displayed only in the workshop; at runtime the level of detail of an object is chosen according to the LOD policy.

manual/gameplay/06ea9874b540cd88.html.title: 3. 游戏运行日志显示 Displaying the Game Runtime Log | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/06ea9874b540cd88.html.keywords: 3. 游戏运行日志显示 Displaying the Game Runtime Log 游戏日志是用于分析游戏卡死原因的主要手段之一。 The game log is one of the main ways to analyze why the game freezes. 开启游戏日志 Enabling the Game Log 出于性能考虑，游戏默认关闭日志。若需要开启，请在模组文件夹中新建一个空文件并命名为 log.debug。请确认系统显示了文件扩展名，避免实际文件名变成 log.debug.txt。 For performance reasons, the game disables logging by default. To enable it, create an empty file named log.debug in the mods folder. Make sure your system is showing file extensions, so that the actual file name does not end up as log.debug.txt. 模组文件夹各平台路径 Path of the mods folder on each platform 安卓决定版：/sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM/files/mods/ Android Definitive Edition: /sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM/files/mods/ 安卓普通版：/sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarOpenSource/files/mods/ Android Standard Edition: /sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarOpenSource/files/mods/ 电脑普通版：SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\mods PC Standard Edition: SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\mods 电脑决定版：SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE\mods PC Definitive Edition: SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE\mods 电脑HDRP版：SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE-HDRP\mods PC HDRP Edition: SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar-DE-HDRP\mods 对于安卓设备，装有 adb 环境，则也可以使用 如下 adb 命令 On an Android device with adb installed, you can also use the following adb command: adb shell touch /sdcard/Android/data/com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM/files/mods/log.debug 调试日志显示 Viewing the Debug Log 然后，你就可以看到游戏内调试窗口显示的运行日志。使用方法: 点击右上角自定义，拉到最下面，开启调试日志。 点击新出现的框，查看报错。 After that, you can see the runtime log in the in-game debug window. How to use it: click Customize in the upper-right corner, scroll down to the bottom, and turn on the debug log. manual/gameplay/2150ee54dfdb5c9b.html.title: 5. 闪退 & 无法进入问题解决方案 Crashes & Failure to Launch: Solutions | Panzer War Document
manual/gameplay/2150ee54dfdb5c9b.html.keywords: 5. 闪退 & 无法进入问题解决方案 Crashes & Failure to Launch: Solutions 此文档记录一些遇到的版本问题，以及解决方案。 This document records some of the version-related problems that have been reported, together with their solutions. 灰屏卡住 Stuck on a Grey Screen 将 Documents/ShanghaiWindy/PanzerWarMods 文件夹重命名为 PanzerWarMods-Bak，进入游戏，车库左侧模组，点击申请外部 SDCard 权限。然后退出游戏，将 Documents/ShanghaiWindy/PanzerWarMods-Bak 重命名为 PanzerWarMods Rename the folder Documents/ShanghaiWindy/PanzerWarMods to PanzerWarMods-Bak, launch the game, open Mods on the left side of the garage, and click to request external SDCard permission. Then quit the game and rename Documents/ShanghaiWindy/PanzerWarMods-Bak back to PanzerWarMods. 闪退 Crashes 在升级完成版本后，进入某个场景发生闪退，可能是由部分老旧数据不兼容导致游戏闪退。解决方案：备份游戏存档，然后删除游戏，重新安装游戏。请务必看备份存档！ If the game crashes when you enter a scene after upgrading to a new version, the crash may be caused by some old data that is no longer compatible. Solution: back up your game saves, then uninstall and reinstall the game. Be sure to read the "Backing Up Saves" section below first! 备份存档 Backing Up Saves 手动备份存档 Backing Up Saves Manually 注意：一定要按如下步骤一步一步进行操作，切记不要跳步骤！ Note: follow the steps below one by one, and never skip a step! 打开文件管理器 选择目录 Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / saves 长按选择复制，复制到 Android / data 目录下。 若同时想要备份模组，可将 Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / mods 长按复制到 Android / data 目录下。 删除游戏，重新安装 正常打开游戏至车库，然后退出游戏 将 Android / data / saves 目录 复制到 Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / saves 下 打开游戏，确认数据 若要恢复模组数据，请完成步骤 1 的备份。然后，将 Android / data / mods 目录 复制到 Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / mods 下 打开游戏，确认 Mod Open your file manager, select the directory Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / saves, long-press it to copy it, and paste it into the Android / data directory. If you also want to back up your mods, long-press Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / mods and copy it into the Android / data directory as well. Uninstall the game, then reinstall it. Launch the game normally, go all the way to the garage, then quit the game. Copy the Android / data / saves directory into Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / saves. Launch the game and check that your data is there. To restore your mod data, you must have made the optional mods backup described in step 1. Then copy the Android / data / mods directory into Android / data / com.ShanghaiWindy.PanzerWarDEM / files / mods. Launch the game and check that your mods are there.

manual/gameplay/a455bddb1c32a23e.html.keywords: 7. Ravenfield 地图模组支持 Ravenfield Map Tool Support 版权合规 Copyrights ** 注意，请勿将没有版权的 Ravenfield 的地图提交到我们游戏的创意工坊，我们会立刻进行删除的处理。在使用此功能前，请确保你拥有正版的 Ravenfield。** 如果你是 Ravenfield 的地图所有者，我们欢迎你将你的 Ravenfield 地图直接提交到装甲纷争的创意工坊！ Attention！ You are not allowed to submit a Ravenfield map to our workshop if you do not have the copyright. And Please be sure you have owned Ravenfield in Steam first! If you are the owner of the Ravenfield map,you are welcome to submit it to our workshop!!! 介绍 Description 针对 Steam 的普通版，我们增加了对 Ravenfield 的创意工坊的支持。 For Panzer War : Lit on Steam, we add support for mod tool maps from Ravenfield. Step.1 如何获取 Ravenfield 的 Mod 地图？How to get Ravenfield mod maps? 打开 Ravenfield 的创意工坊 https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=636480&requiredtags[]=Maps+-+Mod+Tools，订阅 Mod Tool 的 Mod 地图，然后在本地的 SteamLibrary\steamapps\workshop\content\636480 路径找到对应的 rfl 文件，此文件即为 Ravenfield 的 Mod 地图 Open the workshop of Ravenfield.https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse/?appid=636480&requiredtags[]=Maps+-+Mod+Tools Subscribe Mod Tool Maps. Then you can find rfl files from SteamLibrary\steamapps\workshop\content\636480 Step.2 如何给装甲纷争安装 Ravenfield 的 Mod 地图 How to install it for Panzer War? 将 Ravenfield 的 rfl 结尾的地图，放在 SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\mods\StandaloneWindows64_RvlMaps 路径下，即可使用 Ravenfield 创意工坊的 Mod 地图。同时，在游戏启动后，会在地图文件路径处生成一份 Yaml，可用于自定义出生点以及寻路点的坐标。 Place rfl files to SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\PanzerWar-DE\dlc\PanzerWar\mods\StandaloneWindows64_RvlMaps Then open the game. A yaml file will be created after game is opened, you can change the yaml to custom the spawn points and patrol points. Q&A 如果出生点出生在异常位置，请使用进阶配置，调整自定义出生点。 If the start point is wrong, please use custom points. 部分地图会导致游戏 Crash。 Some maps will crash game. 进阶：如何配置自定义出生点 Advance: Configure custom points 在放完 rfl 文件后，重新启动一次游戏。即会在 rfl 同目录下，生成一个 yaml 文件 将 isCustomPoints 的 false 改为 true，修改下方 x,y,z 坐标为想要的位置 Config the yaml file created in step.2 # @Comment: 是否自定义出生点 @Type: System.Boolean isCustomPoints: false # @Comment: A 队出生点 @Type: ShanghaiWindy.Core.Data.SerializeVector3[] customTeamASpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 # @Comment: B 队出生点 @Type: ShanghaiWindy.Core.Data.SerializeVector3[] customTeamBSpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 # @Comment: 寻路点 @Type: ShanghaiWindy.Core.Data.SerializeVector3[] customPartolPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 # @Comment: 寻路烘培参数 @Type: System.Int32 tileSize: 512 # @Comment: 寻路烘培参数 @Type: System.Single voxelSize: 2 可添加多个出生点以及寻路点，如下图所示 customTeamASpawnPoints: - x: 0 y: 0 z: 0 - x: -4 y: 0 z: -4 - x: 4 y: 0 z: 4 进阶：如何打包为 ModPackage Advance: Pack it as a ModPackage 将 rfl 与 对应 yaml 文件 用 zip 形式进行压缩，然后将后缀从 zip 改为 modpack ，将文件命名改为 StandaloneWindows64_任意名称.modpack ，即可随地图与出生点配置信息分享给其他人。 Compress the rfl file and its matching yaml file into a zip archive, then change the extension from zip to modpack and rename the file to StandaloneWindows64_AnyName.modpack. You can then share the map together with its spawn point configuration with other people.

manual/gameplay/a8295f493b3a416d.html.keywords: 1. 游戏调试工具 Game Debugging Tools 热更下载渠道修改 Changing the Hot-Update Download Channel 默认游戏是下载生产环境的热更文件，通过修改一个文件，可使游戏从测试环境下载热更新。 测试环境的热更新往往比生产环境的热更文件要新，但是也意味着可能存在 bug。在测试环境遇到 bug 需要及时上报给开发者。 By default the game downloads hot-update files from the production environment. By editing one file, you can make the game download hot updates from the test environment instead. Hot updates on the test environment are usually newer than the ones on production, but that also means they may contain bugs. To list all of the debug commands, type help. 用于检查是否有部分资源在制作时候，或者安装后有所损坏，导致游戏卡死。 They are used to check whether some resources were damaged while being made, or after they were installed, which can cause the game to freeze. 此检查会检查所有读取到的资源，所以过程会比较漫长。 The check goes through every resource that has been loaded, so it takes quite a while. 如果要检查是不是有 DIY 忘记生成预制体了，则输入 DebugDIY 。 If you want to check whether a DIY item is missing its generated prefab, type DebugDIY.

manual/mod/26792c7bc7a611b8.html.keywords: 02.10 反应装甲 Reactive Armor Size ： 表示反应装甲每一块区域的大小。 区域越小，对坦克的保护则越强 Reactive Armor Size: the size of each cell of the reactive armor. The smaller the cell, the stronger the protection it gives the tank. Reactive MaxProtect Penetration ： 表示反应装甲最大可以保护多少穿深的炮弹 Reactive MaxProtect Penetration: the maximum shell penetration that the reactive armor can protect against. 机制： Mechanism: 反应装甲按区域大小被划分为几个区域， The reactive armor is divided into several cells according to the cell size. 在反应装甲的一块区域抵挡了一次炮弹后，则失效变为间隙装甲，间隙装甲厚度为 Armor。其他区域不受影响。 Once a cell of the reactive armor has blocked one shell, that cell fails and becomes intermittent armor whose thickness equals Armor. The other cells are unaffected.

manual/mod/26cce7681110c2c5.html.title: 22.6.2 Lua 中 self. 与 self: 的区别 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/26cce7681110c2c5.html.keywords: 22.6.2 Lua 中 self. 与 self: 的区别 在 Lua 编程语言中，self. 和 self: 之间的区别主要与方法调用和表中的函数有关。它们都用于访问表（table）中的字段和方法，但是在传递参数时有所不同。 In the Lua programming language, the difference between self. and self: mainly concerns method calls and functions stored in a table. Both are used to access the fields and methods of a table, but they differ in how arguments are passed. self.：当你在表（table）中使用 self. 调用一个函数时，你需要显式地传递表的实例作为第一个参数。这种情况下，函数的定义通常如下： self.: when you call a function in a table with self., you must pass the table instance explicitly as the first argument. In this case the function is usually defined like this: local myTable = {} function myTable.func(self, arg1, arg2) -- 在这里，self 是表的实例 -- arg1 和 arg2 是其他参数 end 调用这个函数时，你需要显式地提供表的实例： When calling this function, you must provide the table instance explicitly: local instance = myTable instance.func(instance, arg1, arg2) self:：使用 self: 调用表中的函数时，Lua 会隐式地将表的实例作为第一个参数传递给函数。这种情况下，函数的定义通常如下： self:: when you call a function in a table with self:, Lua implicitly passes the table instance to the function as the first argument. In this case the function is usually defined like this: local myTable = {} function myTable:func(arg1, arg2) -- 在这里，self 是表的实例，已隐式地传递 -- arg1 和 arg2 是其他参数 end 调用这个函数时，你不需要显式地提供表的实例： When calling this function, you do not need to provide the table instance explicitly: local instance = myTable instance:func(arg1, arg2) 总结：self. 和 self: 的主要区别在于传递表实例的方式。使用 self. 时，需要显式地将实例作为第一个参数传递；而使用 self: 时，表实例会被隐式地传递。在面向对象编程中，self: 通常更加方便，因为它可以简化代码。 Summary: the main difference between self. and self: is how the table instance is passed. With self. you must pass the instance explicitly as the first argument; with self: the table instance is passed implicitly. In object-oriented programming self: is usually more convenient, because it simplifies the code.

Upload Standards 上传规范 每个分支，都应该尽量少的修改内容。 小到： 以一个坦克或飞机的修改为一个分支。切记，不要在一个分支内，提交大量的载具修改，然后再进行合并，此类合并将无法通过。 Each branch should contain as few changes as possible — ideally one branch per tank or aircraft. Never commit a large batch of vehicle changes on a single branch and then ask for a merge; such merges will not be accepted. 2. Naming Standards 命名规范 任何的文件应该以大写字母开头，然后接小写字母如： Every file name should begin with an uppercase letter followed by lowercase letters, for example: 任何的文件，都应该有一个清晰明确的名称，而非一串乱码之类的 Every file should have a clear, meaningful name instead of a string of gibberish. 尽量不要拼错单词 Try not to misspell words. 3. When Modifying an Existing Model, Replace the Fbx Instead of Adding a New One 在原本模型上进行修改，应替换 Fbx 而非新增 Fbx 导出新的 fbx，覆盖原本的 fbx 文件。 此步骤可在建模软件导出时候覆盖，或者在文件夹中复制进行覆盖。无法在 Unity 编辑器内直接完成。如果在 fbx 内新增模型，则将新的 fbx 拖入空场景，然后复制新增部分到原本老的预制体内。 Export the new fbx and overwrite the original fbx file. You can overwrite it while exporting from your modelling software, or by copying the file over in the folder. This cannot be done directly inside the Unity editor. If you added new models inside the fbx, drag the new fbx into an empty scene, then copy the newly added parts into the original old prefab. 切记，不要因为对 fbx 新增一块区域的模型，就只是新增一个 fbx 文件。 会导致 XXX_fix.fbx XXX_fix2.fbx ... 这样的情况，导致项目文件混乱。 Never add a separate fbx file just because you added one more piece of geometry. It leads to XXX_fix.fbx, XXX_fix2.fbx and so on, which turns the project files into a mess. 4. Do Not Reuse One Texture for Both Normal and RGB Maps, and Do Not Set Normal Strength 法线图与 RGB 图不要用一张，不要设置 Normal 强度 解决方法： Solution: 在建模软件里不要将 RGB 图引用给 Normal，也不要设置 Normal 强度 In your modelling software, do not feed the RGB map into Normal, and do not set the Normal strength. 如：Blender 中删除以下节点 For example, in Blender, delete the following node: 以及删除以下节点 And delete the following node as well: 5. Avoid Duplicate Materials 避免重复的材质球 重复的材质球指的是 相同的贴图，但是使用了不同的材质球。这个会造成渲染压力的增加。 Duplicate materials means separate materials that use exactly the same textures. This increases the rendering cost. 重复的材质球出现的情况一般是在 Blender 里使用了 ctrl c + ctrl v。 我们建议使用 shift +d 的方式复制物体，以避免创建重复的材质球。 Duplicate materials usually appear after copying objects in Blender with Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V. We recommend duplicating objects with Shift+D instead, so that no duplicate material is created. 对于已经创建了的重复材质球，则需要手动的在 Blender 里，把引用的材质球都换成相同的，以避免重复。 For duplicates that already exist, you have to switch the referenced materials manually in Blender so that they all point to the same material. 下拉框可以看目前还有哪些材质有重复，一般重复的材质都会以 .001,.002 结尾。 The dropdown shows which materials are still duplicated; duplicated ones normally end with .001, .002 and so on. 可以在上面的搜索框，搜索重复的材质名称 You can use the search box above to look up duplicated material names.

manual/mod/4f72a64906a43e48.html.title: 22.5.5 自定义 Lua Buff | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/4f72a64906a43e48.html.keywords: 22.5.5 自定义 Lua Buff --- 添加 Buff 测试 local TestAddBuff = class("TestAddBuff") Common() -- 定义装填 Buff local ReloadBuff = class("ReloadBuff") function ReloadBuff:GetBuffDisplayName() return "Lua 减少装填时间 Buff" end function ReloadBuff:ctor() self.IsMultipleCoff = false self.IsZeroBuff = false self.CoffValue = -0.5 self.ConstValue = 0 end function ReloadBuff:ApplyBuff(receiver) local ret, tank = BuffAPI.TryGetBuffReceiverAsTank(receiver) if ret then tank.vehicleComponents.mainTankFire.ReloadSpeedBuffedCoff:AddBuff(self._buffCaster) end print("add buff") end function ReloadBuff:RemoveBuff(receiver, isInterrupt) local ret, tank = BuffAPI.TryGetBuffReceiverAsTank(receiver) if ret then tank.vehicleComponents.mainTankFire.ReloadSpeedBuffedCoff:RemoveBuff(self._buffCaster) end print("remove buff") end function TestAddBuff:OnStarted() -- 将 Lua table 转为 C# 对象 local buffCaster = ConvertAPI.CovertToBuffCaster(ReloadBuff.new()) InputAPI.RegisterKeyInput("add buff", "F1", function() BuffAPI.AddBuff(VehicleAPI.GetPlayerVehicle(), buffCaster) end, function() end) InputAPI.RegisterKeyInput("remove buff", "F2", function() BuffAPI.RemoveBuff(VehicleAPI.GetPlayerVehicle(), buffCaster) end, function() end) end return TestAddBuff

manual/mod/5853a029b1c97a76.html.keywords: 10. Encryption 加密模组 The encryption mod is a way to encourage modders to create high quality mods. You can only create the encryption mods to player if you created your mod without copyright issues. In other word,you can't use models from other games such as World of Tanks / War Thunder to make encryption mods. If you make encryption mods with copyright issues,the developer has rights to close your account and revoke all the keys you have generated. This agreement will affect all the mod package that is created after 2020/7/5. You can purchase models from CGTrader / Unity asset store and other cg stores to create encryption mods. Mod Mirror Site Setup Guide 模组镜像站点搭建指南 Source 源 We have compiled all the mods, their update dates, and download links in the following JSON file: We will refresh this JSON file every 12 hours. https://dl-workshop.windyverse.net/packages/files_list.json 我们将所有的模组，更新日期与其下载链接，放在了如下 json 文件中。 我们会每12小时刷新一次本 json。 https://dl-workshop.windyverse.net/packages/files_list.json Run script 一键下载脚本 We have thoughtfully prepared a Python script for you that allows one-click downloading of all mods. You can use it directly. 我们贴心的为各位准备了一键下载所有模组的 python 脚本，可供各位直接使用。 Dependence 脚本依赖 Before running the script, please ensure that the following dependencies are installed in your Python environment: 在运行脚本之前，请确保您的 Python 环境中已安装以下依赖项： requests: for handling HTTP requests. 用于处理 HTTP 请求。 tqdm: for displaying progress bars. 用于显示进度条。 You can install the dependencies using the following command: 您可以通过以下命令安装依赖： pip install requests tqdm Run Script 运行脚本 import os import json import requests import zipfile import re from datetime import datetime from tqdm import tqdm # Path to the JSON file that tracks downloaded files TRACKING_FILE = 'downloaded_files.json' TEMP_DIR = 'tmp' # Temporary directory for incomplete downloads SAVE_DIR = 'packages' # Base directory where all files will be saved PLATFORM_FOLDERS = { 'PlatformAndroid': 'android', 'PlatformWin64': 'win64', 'PlatformIos': 'ios' } def load_downloaded_files(): """Load the list of downloaded files from the tracking JSON file.""" if os.path.exists(TRACKING_FILE): with open(TRACKING_FILE, 'r') as file: return json.load(file) return {} def save_downloaded_file(downloaded_files, url, local_path): """Save the downloaded file information to the tracking JSON file.""" downloaded_files[url] = local_path with open(TRACKING_FILE, 'w') as file: json.dump(downloaded_files, file, indent=4) def sanitize_mod_name(mod_name): # Remove only special characters that are not allowed in file names return re.sub(r'[<>:"/\\|?*]', '', mod_name) def download_file(url, temp_path): try: response = requests.get(url, stream=True) response.raise_for_status() total_size = int(response.headers.get('content-length', 0)) block_size = 8192 # 8KB progress_bar = tqdm(total=total_size, unit='iB', unit_scale=True, desc=os.path.basename(temp_path), leave=False) with open(temp_path, 'wb') as file: for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=block_size): progress_bar.update(len(chunk)) file.write(chunk) progress_bar.close() if total_size != 0 and progress_bar.n != total_size: print(f"Warning: Downloaded file size mismatch for {temp_path}") else: print(f"Downloaded: {temp_path}") except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: print(f"Failed to download {url}: {e}") def extract_mod_name_from_zip(zip_path): if os.path.exists(zip_path): # Check if the file exists before attempting to open it with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'r') as zip_ref: if 'package.json' in zip_ref.namelist(): with zip_ref.open('package.json') as package_file: package_data = json.load(package_file) # Check for defaultName in localizedModName mod_name = package_data.get('modName', 'default') localized_mod_name = package_data.get('localizedModName', {}) default_name = localized_mod_name.get('defaultName', '').strip() # Prioritize defaultName if it exists and is not empty if default_name: mod_name = default_name return sanitize_mod_name(mod_name) return None def validate_downloaded_files(downloaded_files): """Check if the files recorded in the tracking JSON exist locally, and remove any entries that don't.""" missing_files = [] for url, path in list(downloaded_files.items()): if not os.path.exists(path): print(f"File missing: {path}. Removing from tracking.") missing_files.append(url) for url in missing_files: del downloaded_files[url] # Save the updated tracking list if missing_files: with open(TRACKING_FILE, 'w') as file: json.dump(downloaded_files, file, indent=4) def download_files_from_json(json_data, downloaded_files): if not os.path.exists(TEMP_DIR): os.makedirs(TEMP_DIR) if not os.path.exists(SAVE_DIR): os.makedirs(SAVE_DIR) with tqdm(total=len(json_data), desc="Overall Progress", unit="file") as overall_progress: for file_info in json_data: file_name = file_info['file_name'] download_link = file_info['download_link'] # Skip if the file is already recorded as downloaded if download_link in downloaded_files: if os.path.exists(downloaded_files[download_link]): print(f"File already downloaded, skipping: {downloaded_files[download_link]}") overall_progress.update(1) continue else: print(f"File {downloaded_files[download_link]} is missing. Redownloading.") del downloaded_files[download_link] # Define the temporary download path temp_file_path = os.path.join(TEMP_DIR, file_name) # Download the file to the temporary location download_file(download_link, temp_file_path) # Extract modName and rename the file with the prefix mod_name = extract_mod_name_from_zip(temp_file_path) if mod_name: new_file_name = f"{mod_name}-#-#-{file_name}" else: new_file_name = file_name # Determine the platform folder based on the filename for platform, folder in PLATFORM_FOLDERS.items(): if platform in file_name: final_dir = os.path.join(SAVE_DIR, folder) break else: final_dir = SAVE_DIR # Default to base save directory if no platform is found if not os.path.exists(final_dir): os.makedirs(final_dir) final_file_path = os.path.join(final_dir, new_file_name) # Move the file from the temporary location to the final directory os.rename(temp_file_path, final_file_path) print(f"Moved to: {final_file_path}") # Update the tracking dictionary save_downloaded_file(downloaded_files, download_link, final_file_path) overall_progress.update(1) if __name__ == "__main__": json_url = 'https://dl-workshop.windyverse.net/packages/files_list.json' try: response = requests.get(json_url) response.raise_for_status() json_data = response.json() except requests.exceptions.RequestException as e: print(f"Failed to retrieve JSON file from {json_url}: {e}") json_data = [] if json_data: downloaded_files = load_downloaded_files() validate_downloaded_files(downloaded_files) # Ensure the tracked files exist download_files_from_json(json_data, downloaded_files) File synchronization to NetDisk 文件同步至网盘 Using UC NetDisk as an example, automatically back up the packages folder and wait for the synchronization to complete. Once the synchronization is finished, share this folder with the players. This completes the setup of the NetDisk mirror site. 以 UC 网盘为例，自动备份选择 packages 文件夹，等待其同步完成。然后将此文件夹共享给玩家，即完成网盘镜像站的搭建。 Alternative Mirror Site Setup Solutions 其他镜像站搭建方案 You can use tools like Nginx to set up a dedicated mod download site. This helps to offload the traffic from the official downloader and improves download speeds. 可使用 nginx 等工具，搭建专属的模组下载站点，以分流官方下载器的压力，并提高下载速度。

manual/mod/7528cd260a094da5.html.title: 18.1 Jenkins 安装与配置教程 Jenkins Installation and Configuration | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/7528cd260a094da5.html.keywords: 18.1 Jenkins 安装与配置教程 Jenkins Installation and Configuration 1. 安装 Jenkins：Installing Jenkins Jenkins 是一款开源的自动化构建工具，你需要先安装 Jenkins。你可以从 Jenkins 的官方网站 https://www.jenkins.io/download/ 上下载适合你系统的 Jenkins 安装包，按照安装向导进行安装。安装成功后，你可以通过在浏览器中输入 http://localhost:8080/ 访问 Jenkins。 Jenkins is an open source automation build tool, and you need to install it first. You can download the Jenkins installer for your system from the Jenkins official website https://www.jenkins.io/download/ and install it by following the setup wizard. After a successful installation you can reach Jenkins by entering http://localhost:8080/ in your browser. 面向小白的详细的安装教程：Step-by-step Installation Guide for Beginners 在你的服务器或本地计算机上打开一个浏览器，并转到 Jenkins 官方网站：https://www.jenkins.io/download/。 On your server or local computer, open a browser and go to the Jenkins official website. 在 Jenkins 的下载页面上，你可以看到不同操作系统的 Jenkins 安装包。选择适合你的操作系统的 Jenkins 安装包下载链接，比如 Windows 系统可以选择 Windows 的 MSI 安装包。 On the Jenkins download page you can see installers for the different operating systems. Pick the download link for your own operating system, for example the Windows MSI installer on Windows. 下载完成后，双击安装包打开安装向导。按照向导的提示，选择安装目录、安装类型等设置。默认情况下，Jenkins 会安装在 C:\Program Files (x86)\Jenkins 目录下。 When the download has finished, double click the installer to open the setup wizard. Follow the prompts to choose the install directory, the install type and other settings. By default Jenkins is installed into C:\Program Files (x86)\Jenkins. 在安装过程中，你需要选择安装 Jenkins 的运行环境。你可以选择安装 Jenkins 的 Windows 服务或者作为一个普通的 Windows 程序运行。对于大多数情况，我们建议安装 Jenkins 的 Windows 服务，以便在系统重启后能够自动启动 Jenkins。 During the installation you need to choose how Jenkins runs. You can install Jenkins as a Windows service or run it as an ordinary Windows program. In most cases we recommend installing it as a Windows service, so that Jenkins starts automatically after the system reboots. 安装完成后，Jenkins 会启动并监听默认的 HTTP 端口 8080。你可以在浏览器中输入 http://localhost:8080/ 访问 Jenkins 的 Web 界面。如果你安装了 Jenkins 的 Windows 服务，那么 Jenkins 会在后台自动运行，并且你可以在 Windows 服务列表中找到它，以便在需要的时候手动启动、停止或重启 Jenkins。 After the installation Jenkins starts and listens on the default HTTP port 8080. You can enter http://localhost:8080/ in your browser to open the Jenkins web interface. If you installed Jenkins as a Windows service it runs in the background automatically, and you can find it in the Windows service list to start, stop or restart it manually when needed. 在首次启动 Jenkins 时，你需要输入管理员帐号的用户名和密码。Jenkins 会要求你选择安装插件，你可以选择推荐的插件或者手动选择需要安装的插件。安装插件需要一些时间，请耐心等待。 The first time Jenkins starts you need to enter the user name and password of the administrator account. Jenkins then asks you to choose which plugins to install; you can take the recommended plugins or select the ones you need manually. Installing the plugins takes a while, so please be patient. 安装完成后，你会看到 Jenkins 的主界面。现在你已经成功安装了 Jenkins，可以开始使用它来构建你的项目。 Once this is done you will see the Jenkins main interface. Jenkins is now installed successfully and you can start using it to build your projects. 2. 安装 Unity3D：Installing Unity3D 在 Jenkins 中打包 Unity3D 项目之前，需要在 Jenkins 服务器上安装 Unity3D。确保安装了适合你项目的 Unity3D 版本。 Before you can build a Unity3D project in Jenkins, Unity3D has to be installed on the Jenkins server. Make sure the Unity3D version you install is the one your project needs. Unity Engine Requirement Unity 引擎版本要求 3. 安装 Unity3D 插件：Installing the Unity3D Plugin 在 Jenkins 中打包 Unity3D 项目，需要安装 Unity3D 插件。打开 Jenkins，进入“插件管理”页面，搜索“Unity3D”并安装。安装成功后，你需要重启 Jenkins。 Building a Unity3D project in Jenkins requires the Unity3D plugin. Open Jenkins, go to the plugin management page, search for "Unity3D" and install it. After a successful installation you need to restart Jenkins. 4. 配置 Jenkins 项目：Configuring the Jenkins Project 进入 Jenkins 项目的“配置”页面。在设置 Unity3D 安装目录路径。 Go to the configuration page of the Jenkins project and set the path of the Unity3D installation directory there. 5. 创建 Jenkins 项目：Creating a Jenkins Project 在 Jenkins 中创建一个新项目。进入 Jenkins 主页，点击“新建项目”按钮，选择“自由风格软件项目”并输入项目名称。 Create a new project in Jenkins. Go to the Jenkins home page, click the new project button, choose the freestyle software project type and enter a project name. 增加一个构建步骤： Add a build step. 选择刚刚配置的 Unity，然后设置如下打包命令 Select the Unity installation you just configured, then set the following build command. -projectPath <项目路径> -batchmode -quit -executeMethod ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest -config <配置文件路径>

manual/mod/7b23656edfd67293.html.title: 18. 持续构建 （脚本化构建模组） Continuous Build (Scripted Mod Building) | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/7b23656edfd67293.html.keywords: 18. 持续构建 （脚本化构建模组） Continuous Build (Scripted Mod Building) 创建持续构建流程，可以更快的进行模组文件的迭代更新，高度自定义打包哪些模组，拷贝至什么文件夹，无需手动操作，也无需打开 Unity 点击任何按钮。 Setting up a continuous build pipeline lets you iterate on mod files faster. You can freely customize which mods are built and which folder they are copied to, without doing anything by hand and without opening Unity to click any button. 1. 创建一个 manifest 描述 json Create a manifest json modNames 为一个数组，填写你要构建的模组包列表。 modNames is an array; fill in the list of mod packages you want to build. copyInfo 会根据平台，将最终生成的文件拷贝到指定目录。(安卓工程则只拷贝安卓文件，Windows 工程则只拷贝 Windows 文件) copyInfo copies the generated files to the given directory according to the platform. (An Android project only copies the Android files, a Windows project only copies the Windows files.) isPackage 为 true 则拷贝 modpackage 为 false 则拷贝 buildpipline 原始资源（传 Steam 创意工坊用） When isPackage is true the modpackage file is copied; when it is false the raw buildpipline assets are copied instead (these are the ones you upload to the Steam Workshop). 案例 TestBuildPipline.json Example TestBuildPipline.json 构建模组包 BuildPipline-Lua-ModeRes 与 BuildPipline-Vehicles ，生成 modpackage 文件。 将安卓平台资源拷贝至 D:/Projects/Android-Ship 将电脑平台资源拷贝至 D:/Projects/Windows-Ship Build the mod packages BuildPipline-Lua-ModeRes and BuildPipline-Vehicles into modpackage files. Copy the Android assets to D:/Projects/Android-Ship and the desktop assets to D:/Projects/Windows-Ship. { "infos": [ { "modNames": [ "BuildPipline-Lua-ModeRes", "BuildPipline-Vehicles" ], "copyInfo": [ { "platform": "Android", "dstDir": "D:/Projects/Android-Ship" }, { "platform": "StandaloneWindows64", "dstDir": "D:/Projects/Windows-Ship" } ], "isPackage" : true } ] } 2. CI 脚本 CI Script 调用 ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest 传入 -config 参数 (manifest 路径) Call ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest and pass the -config argument (the path of the manifest). 案例 BuildPiplineCI.sh Example BuildPiplineCI.sh projectDir 为你的 Unity 项目路径 projectDir is the path of your Unity project. manifestDir 为 步骤.1 中的 manifest 的 json 文件的路径 manifestDir is the path of the manifest json file from step 1. editorDir 为你的 Unity 安装路径 editorDir is the path where Unity is installed. logPath 为你的打包日志输出路径 logPath is the output path of the build log. （Windows 上执行 bash，可安装一个 git，然后通过 git bash 执行以下脚本） (To run bash on Windows, install git and then run the following script through git bash.) projectDir="D:\Projects\PanzerWar-URP" manifestDir="D:\Projects\PanzerWar-URP\CLI\BuildPiplineCI\TestBuildPipline.json" editorDir="H:\UnityEditor\2021.3.0f1\Editor\Unity.exe" logPath="D:\Projects\PanzerWar-URP\CLI\BuildPiplineCI\log.txt" $editorDir -projectPath $projectDir -batchmode -quit -executeMethod ShanghaiWindy.Editor.Utility_BuildPipline.DoBuildPiplineManifest -config $manifestDir -logFile $logPath 完整的构建案例，可直接查看 PanzerWar-Mods\UnityProject\BuildPiplineCI 文件夹， **调整 **BuildPiplineCI.sh 为自己项目的路径，用 git bash 方式执行即可。 For a complete build example, look at the PanzerWar-Mods\UnityProject\BuildPiplineCI folder. Change the paths in BuildPiplineCI.sh to the ones of your own project and run it through git bash. 3. Jenkins 集成 Jenkins Integration Jenkins 安装与配置教程 4. 特殊情况 Special Cases 1. BuildPipline 位于 ModManager 的子文件夹 BuildPipline in a Subfolder of ModManager 这种情况，需要 modNames 设置名称时候，也要加上前缀 In this case the name you write in modNames has to carry the prefix as well. 比如位于 Assets/ModManager/AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX For example, for a mod located at Assets/ModManager/AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX 则填写 AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX you write AAAA/BBBB/Vehicle-XXX.

manual/mod/80484eb82955b342.html.title: 26.4. Fmod Profiler | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/80484eb82955b342.html.keywords: 26.4. Fmod Profiler Profiler 是 FMOD Studio 中的一个实用工具，可以实时查看 Unity 引擎中发生的音频事件、内存使用、CPU 使用等信息。要在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 中连接 Unity 引擎，请遵循以下步骤： The Profiler is a utility in FMOD Studio that lets you watch the audio events, memory usage and CPU usage of the Unity engine in real time. To connect the Unity engine to the FMOD Studio Profiler, follow these steps. 打开 FMOD Studio：启动 FMOD Studio 并打开你的音频项目。 Open FMOD Studio: launch FMOD Studio and open your audio project. 打开 Profiler：在 FMOD Studio 的顶部菜单栏中，点击 "Window"，然后选择 "Profiler"。这将打开 Profiler 窗口。 Open the Profiler: in the top menu bar of FMOD Studio, click "Window" and then select "Profiler". This opens the Profiler window. 启动 Unity：确保 Unity 项目已打开，并在 Unity 中加载包含 FMOD 插件的场景。 Start Unity: make sure the Unity project is open and load the scene that contains the FMOD plugin. 设置连接：回到 Unity，点击顶部菜单栏中的 "FMOD"，然后选择 "Edit Settings"。在 Inspector 窗口中，展开 "Live Update" 部分，并勾选 "Enable Live Update"。确保 "Live Update Port" 与 FMOD Studio Profiler 中的端口设置相匹配（默认为 9264）。 Set up the connection: back in Unity, click "FMOD" in the top menu bar and select "Edit Settings". In the Inspector window, expand the "Live Update" section and tick "Enable Live Update". Make sure "Live Update Port" matches the port configured in the FMOD Studio Profiler (9264 by default). 激活实时更新：在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 窗口中，点击 "Live Update" 按钮，确保它已激活。激活后，按钮的背景颜色应为绿色。这将允许 FMOD Studio 与 Unity 引擎实时同步音频数据。 Activate live update: in the Profiler window of FMOD Studio, click the "Live Update" button and make sure it is active. Once active, the background of the button turns green. This lets FMOD Studio synchronize audio data with the Unity engine in real time. 连接 Profiler：现在，回到 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 窗口。点击录制的圆形按钮 Connect the Profiler: now go back to the Profiler window of FMOD Studio and click the round record button. 开始调试：现在，可以开始在 Unity 中运行你的场景。在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 窗口中，你可以实时查看 Unity 引擎中的音频事件、内存使用、CPU 使用等信息，从而更好地分析和调试音量问题。 Start debugging: you can now run your scene in Unity. In the Profiler window of FMOD Studio you can watch the audio events, memory usage and CPU usage of the Unity engine in real time, which makes it easier to analyze and debug volume problems. 检查音效 Checking the Audio 在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 中，可以通过以下方法对比并诊断音量问题： In the FMOD Studio Profiler you can compare and diagnose volume problems in the following ways. 检查事件的实时音量：在 Profiler 窗口的左侧栏中，可以查看正在播放的音频事件。选中其中一个事件，然后在右侧栏中可以看到该事件的实时音量数据。观察音量数据，检查是否有异常波动或值过低的情况。 Check the real-time volume of an event: the left panel of the Profiler window lists the audio events that are playing. Select one of them and the right panel shows its real-time volume data. Watch that data and check whether it fluctuates abnormally or is too low. 使用 Mixer 查看音量：在 FMOD Studio 的顶部菜单栏中，点击 "Window"，然后选择 "Mixer"。这将打开 Mixer 窗口。在 Mixer 中，你可以查看不同总线的音量以及它们之间的关系。请注意，如果 Profiler 中的 "Live Update" 已连接到 Unity，Mixer 也会显示实时音量数据。检查各个总线的音量，以确保它们没有低于预期的值。 Use the Mixer to inspect volume: in the top menu bar of FMOD Studio, click "Window" and select "Mixer" to open the Mixer window. There you can see the volume of the different buses and how they relate to each other. Note that when "Live Update" in the Profiler is connected to Unity, the Mixer also shows real-time volume data. Check the volume of each bus to make sure none of them is lower than expected. 监听音频：在 Profiler 的 "Live Update" 已连接到 Unity 时，你可以实时收听 Unity 中播放的音频。这样，你可以直接比较 FMOD Studio 和 Unity 中的音频效果，并判断音量是否存在问题。 Listen to the audio: while "Live Update" in the Profiler is connected to Unity, you can listen to the audio playing in Unity in real time. This lets you compare the result in FMOD Studio with the result in Unity directly and judge whether there is a volume problem. 记录并分析：在 Profiler 窗口中，你可以点击 "Record" 按钮开始录制音频性能数据。录制完成后，你可以详细分析音量、CPU 使用、内存使用等数据，找出可能的问题所在。 Record and analyze: in the Profiler window you can click the "Record" button to start recording audio performance data. When the recording is finished you can analyze volume, CPU usage and memory usage in detail to find where the problem may be. 对比预期效果：如果你有音频效果的预期结果（例如，之前的录音或参考音频），你可以将实时播放的音频与预期结果进行对比。这有助于判断音量是否有问题。 Compare against the expected result: if you have an expected result for the audio (for example an earlier recording or a reference track), you can compare the audio playing in real time against it. This helps you judge whether the volume is wrong. 通过这些方法，你可以在 FMOD Studio 的 Profiler 中对比并诊断音量问题。请注意，音量问题可能源于 FMOD 项目设置、音频文件的初始音量、Unity 中的音量设置等多种原因。在诊断问题时，请全面检查各个方面的设置。 With these methods you can compare and diagnose volume problems in the FMOD Studio Profiler. Keep in mind that a volume problem can come from many places: the FMOD project settings, the initial volume of the audio file, the volume settings in Unity, and so on. When diagnosing, check the settings on every side.

Create Mech 创建机甲 在阅读此文本之前，请务必有普通坦克模组的开发经验。 Before reading this document, make sure you already have experience developing a normal tank mod. 前期准备 Preparation 1. 模型 Model 骨骼模型：一个绑定骨骼的机甲模型。 Skeletal model: a mech model with a rigged skeleton. 伤害模型：一个将各个关节分离的简易的伤害模型。 Damage model: a simple damage model with each joint separated. 2. 动画 Animation 你至少需要拥有以下动画： 待机动画 走路动画：笔直向前走路动画，向左的走路动画，向右的走路动画，原地左转的动画，和原地向右的动画。 You need at least the following animations: Idle animation Walking animations: walking straight forward, walking to the left, walking to the right, turning left in place, and turning right in place. 注：倒退走路动画可以在动画树中，以-1倍的速度播放，实现倒退。 Note: the backward walking animation can be produced by playing the animation at -1x speed in the animator controller. 你可以额外制作以下动画: 飞行动画：飞行起步动画，飞行中待机动画，和飞行结束落地动画。 You can additionally create the following animations: Flight animations: the take-off animation, the in-flight idle animation, and the landing animation at the end of the flight. 3. 导入引擎动画的设置 Animation Import Settings 动画导入引擎后有相关设置，才可以使机甲符合物理模拟效果。 After the animations are imported into the engine, a few settings are required so the mech matches the physics simulation. 需要将 Root Transform Position (Y) 中的 Bake Into Pose 勾上。 Tick Bake Into Pose under Root Transform Position (Y). 在 Curve 增加 GravityWeight 属性，并将曲线设置为值为1的水平线。 Add a GravityWeight property under Curves, and set the curve to a horizontal line with a value of 1. 含脚步落地的动画帧，在 Events 中添加 WalkSound 事件。 On the animation frames where a foot touches the ground, add a WalkSound event under Events. 载具属性设置 Vehicle Property Setup 机甲预制体制作 Building the Mech Prefab 动画控制器。在含有Animator组件的物体上增加 MechAnimatorController 组件 和 CharacterController 组件。 Animator controller. On the object that holds the Animator component, add the MechAnimatorController component and the CharacterController component. 物理碰撞。调整 CharacterController 的属性，使胶囊体底部与脚底一致。 Physics collision. Adjust the CharacterController properties so that the bottom of the capsule lines up with the soles of the feet. 机甲脚底碰撞。在机甲两个脚底均增加 MechLegEndPoint 组件，与BoxCollider 组件。并勾选 BoxCollider 的 isTrigger 属性。若机甲可以飞行，则增加 MechFireBurst 组件,并调整相应参数。 Mech foot collision. Add a MechLegEndPoint component and a BoxCollider component to both of the mech's feet, and tick the isTrigger property on the BoxCollider. If the mech can fly, also add the MechFireBurst component and adjust its parameters. 炮塔同步。增加 Turret/Gun/Dym 的空物体。在机甲模型上，上半身旋转控制的位置增加 MechTurretSync 组件，来同步相应位置。 Turret sync. Create empty objects for Turret/Gun/Dym. On the mech model, add the MechTurretSync component at the position that drives the upper-body rotation, so the corresponding positions stay in sync. 动画树制作 Building the Animator Controller 在 Project 新增 Animator Controller 并拖入机甲预制体含Animator的组件上。 Create a new Animator Controller in the Project window and drag it onto the Animator component of the mech prefab. 增加如下参数。 类型一定要与图中一致。 Add the parameters shown below. The types must match the picture exactly. 增加动画状态。 若含飞行的三个状态动画，则一定要与图中的三个Jet开头的动画命名一致。 Add the animation states. If you include the three flight state animations, their names must match the three Jet-prefixed animation names in the picture. 向前走路（Walk）由多个动画的混合组成（Blend Tree）。 混合使用的参数为 Turn。0.5为笔直向前的动画。 0为向左的走路动画，1为向右的走路动画。可以在中间插入更多动画作补帧，使动画更加自然。 Walking forward (Walk) is a blend of several animations (a Blend Tree). The blend parameter is Turn: 0.5 is the straight-forward animation, 0 is the walk-left animation, and 1 is the walk-right animation. You can insert more animations in between to fill in the motion and make it look more natural. 注：倒退动画可以在动画树中，以-1倍的速度播放，实现倒退。 Note: the backward animation can be produced by playing the animation at -1x speed in the animator controller. 动画转换条件。在下图出现的连线，需要增加如图的条件。 Transition conditions. The transitions shown in the pictures below need the conditions shown in those pictures. 向前走路动画条件 Walk forward condition: 向后走路动画条件 Walk backward condition: 向左走路动画条件 Walk left condition: 向右走路动画条件 Walk right condition: 若含飞行动画，则飞行落地动画条件 If you include flight animations, the flight landing condition: 从 Idle 转到其他状态，无需设置 Has Exit Time。其他状态转到 Idle ，则需要设置 Has Exit Time。 Transitions from Idle to other states do not need Has Exit Time. Transitions from other states back to Idle do need Has Exit Time. 注意:游戏的输入为 Walk 与 Turn 。Walk 的范围为 -1到1。Turn的范围为 0到1。 可以根据自己的动画，设置更加复杂的动画切换。 动画系统的条件切换可以在引擎内直接进行调试，可访问 Unity 动画教程了解更多详情。 Note: the game's inputs are Walk and Turn. Walk ranges from -1 to 1, and Turn ranges from 0 to 1. You can set up more complex animation transitions to suit your own animations. Animation transition conditions can be debugged directly inside the engine — see the Unity animation tutorials for more details. 创建 VehicleData Creating VehicleData 像普通坦克一样，创建坦克配置参数。然后删除生成的 VehicleTrack 文件。 Create the vehicle configuration parameters just like you would for a normal tank, then delete the generated VehicleTrack file. 其他配置信息和坦克一样进行配置即可。 All the other configuration can be done exactly the same way as for a tank. 在 VehicleTextData 需要额外关心，设置机甲专用参数。 VehicleTextData needs extra attention: set the mech-specific parameters there.

manual/mod/905c966e33c0018b.html.title: 22.4 如何使用 LuaBehaviorMono 组件 How to Use the LuaBehaviorMono Component | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/905c966e33c0018b.html.keywords: 22.4 如何使用 LuaBehaviorMono 组件 How to Use the LuaBehaviorMono Component 这份文档是为小白用户编写的，旨在帮助您了解如何使用 LuaBehaviorMono 组件。在这里，我们不会涉及任何代码细节，而是从用户的角度解释组件的功能和用法。 This document is written for beginners and is meant to help you understand how to use the LuaBehaviorMono component. It does not cover any code details; instead it explains what the component does and how to use it from a user's point of view. 1. 简介 Introduction LuaBehaviorMono 是一个 Unity 组件，它允许您将 Lua 脚本绑定到 Unity 游戏对象上。这样，您可以通过编写 Lua 脚本来实现游戏逻辑，而无需编写 C# 代码。这对于使用 Lua 作为脚本语言的游戏开发者来说非常有用。 LuaBehaviorMono is a Unity component that lets you bind a Lua script to a Unity GameObject. This way you can implement game logic by writing Lua scripts instead of C# code, which is very useful for developers who use Lua as their scripting language. 2. 如何使用 LuaBehaviorMono 组件 How to Use the LuaBehaviorMono Component 要使用 LuaBehaviorMono 组件，您需要先将它添加到 Unity 游戏对象上。以下是使用组件的基本步骤： To use the LuaBehaviorMono component you first need to add it to a Unity GameObject. The basic steps are as follows: 2.1 添加组件 Adding the Component 在 Unity 编辑器中，选择您想要添加 LuaBehaviorMono 组件的游戏对象。 In the Unity editor, select the GameObject you want to add the LuaBehaviorMono component to. 在检查器面板中，点击 "Add Component" 按钮。 In the Inspector panel, click the "Add Component" button. 在搜索框中输入 "LuaBehaviorMono"，然后选择 "LuaBehaviorMono" 组件。 Type "LuaBehaviorMono" into the search box, then select the "LuaBehaviorMono" component. 2.2 设置 Lua 行为脚本 Setting the Lua Behavior Script 在检查器面板中，找到 "LuaBehaviorMono" 组件。 In the Inspector panel, find the "LuaBehaviorMono" component. 将您的 Lua 行为脚本拖拽到 "行为脚本 - Behavior" 区域。 Drag your Lua behavior script into the "行为脚本 - Behavior" field. 2.3 设置实例属性 Setting Instance Properties 在检查器面板中，找到 "LuaBehaviorMono" 组件。 In the Inspector panel, find the "LuaBehaviorMono" component. 在 "实例属性 - Instance Property" 区域，点击加号按钮添加新的实例属性。 In the "实例属性 - Instance Property" area, click the plus button to add a new instance property. 为实例属性设置名称和值。 Set a name and a value for the instance property. 3. 注意事项 Notes 如果您想要访问其他游戏对象上的 LuaBehaviorMono 组件，可以使用 GetLuaComponent 方法。 If you want to access a LuaBehaviorMono component on another GameObject, use the GetLuaComponent method. 若要访问 Unity 原生组件，可以使用 GetNativeComponent 方法。 To access a native Unity component, use the GetNativeComponent method. 通过以上步骤，您应该已经了解了如何使用 LuaBehaviorMono 组件。祝您在游戏开发过程中一切顺利！ After following the steps above you should understand how to use the LuaBehaviorMono component. Good luck with your game development!

manual/mod/9270a2607dfcd0fb.html.title: 22.3 安装 VS Code 和配置 Emmy Lua 环境 Installing VS Code and Setting Up Emmy Lua | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/9270a2607dfcd0fb.html.keywords: 22.3 安装 VS Code 和配置 Emmy Lua 环境 Installing VS Code and Setting Up Emmy Lua Visual Studio Code（以下简称 VS Code）是一款由微软推出的免费且开源的代码编辑器。而 Emmy Lua 是一款专为 Lua 语言开发者设计的插件。在本文中，我们将介绍如何安装 VS Code 并配置 Emmy Lua 环境，以便进行 Lua 开发。 Visual Studio Code (VS Code for short) is a free and open-source code editor from Microsoft, and Emmy Lua is a plugin designed for Lua developers. This article explains how to install VS Code and configure the Emmy Lua environment so that you can develop in Lua. 安装 VS Code Installing VS Code 首先，我们需要下载并安装 VS Code。请按照以下步骤操作： 访问 VS Code 官网。 点击 “Download for Windows”（如果你使用 Windows 操作系统）或 “Download for Mac”（如果你使用 macOS 操作系统）。 根据你的操作系统选择适合的安装程序，并下载。 运行下载好的安装程序，并按照提示进行安装。 First we need to download and install VS Code. Follow these steps: Visit the VS Code official site. Click “Download for Windows” (if you use Windows) or “Download for Mac” (if you use macOS). Choose the installer that matches your operating system and download it. Run the downloaded installer and follow the prompts to complete the installation. 或者，可以从以下链接进行安装 Alternatively, you can install it from the link below: https://vscode.cdn.azure.cn/stable/3a6960b964327f0e3882ce18fcebd07ed191b316/VSCodeUserSetup-x64-1.62.2.exe 安装 Emmy Lua Installing Emmy Lua 安装 VS Code 后，我们需要安装 Emmy Lua 插件。请按照以下步骤操作： 打开 VS Code。 点击左侧的扩展图标（或按下快捷键 Ctrl + Shift + X）。 在搜索框中输入 “Emmy Lua” 并选择第一个搜索结果。 点击 “Install” 按钮，等待插件安装完成。 After installing VS Code, we need to install the Emmy Lua plugin. Follow these steps: Open VS Code. Click the Extensions icon on the left side (or press Ctrl + Shift + X). Type “Emmy Lua” into the search box and select the first result. Click the “Install” button and wait for the plugin to finish installing. 配置 Emmy Lua 环境 Configuring the Emmy Lua Environment 配置 Emmy Lua 环境需要先安装 JDK。如果你已经安装了 JDK，可以跳过本节内容。 Configuring the Emmy Lua environment requires the JDK to be installed first. If you already have the JDK installed, you can skip this section. 安装 JDK Installing the JDK jdk 版本推荐在 "1.8.0_181" 以上 A JDK version of "1.8.0_181" or newer is recommended. 访问 JDK 下载页面。 选择适合你操作系统的版本，并下载。 运行下载好的安装程序，并按照提示进行安装。 Visit the JDK download page. Choose the version that matches your operating system and download it. Run the downloaded installer and follow the prompts to complete the installation. 更加详细的步骤看此文档 For more detailed steps, see this document: 如何安装 JDK（Java Development Kit） 配置 Emmy Lua 环境 Configuring the Emmy Lua Environment 安装完 JDK 后，如果没有设置 JDK 的环境变量则我们需要对 Emmy Lua 插件进行一些简单的配置。请按照以下步骤操作： After installing the JDK, if you have not set the JDK environment variable, you need to do a little configuration on the Emmy Lua plugin. Follow these steps: 打开 VS Code。 Open VS Code. 点击左侧的扩展图标（或按下快捷键 Ctrl + Shift + X）。 Click the Extensions icon on the left side (or press Ctrl + Shift + X). 在已安装的插件列表中找到 “Emmy Lua” 插件，并点击右侧的 “Extension Settings” 按钮。 In the list of installed plugins, find the “Emmy Lua” plugin and click the “Extension Settings” button on the right. 在弹出的配置面板中，找到 “Emmy: Java Home” 选项，并填入 JDK 的安装路径。 In the settings panel that opens, find the “Emmy: Java Home” option and fill in the JDK installation path. *"emmylua.java.home": "<你的路径>" 注意，路径需要用 / 分割，而非 * "emmylua.java.home": "<your path>" — note that the path must be separated with / rather than a backslash. - 在 Windows 上，默认安装路径为 **C:/Program Files/Java/jdk{版本号}**。 - On Windows, the default installation path is **C:/Program Files/Java/jdk{version}**. - 在 macOS 上，默认安装路径为 **/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk{版本号}/Contents/Home**。 - On macOS, the default installation path is **/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk{version}/Contents/Home**. 配置完成后，关闭配置面板。 Once the configuration is done, close the settings panel. 至此，我们已经成功安装了 VS Code 和 JDK，并配置了 Emmy Lua 环境，可以开始愉快地进行 Lua 开发了。 At this point we have successfully installed VS Code and the JDK and configured the Emmy Lua environment, so you can start enjoying Lua development.

manual/mod/a959935529849dd1.html.keywords: 22.5.4 场景功能：随机陨石 Scene Feature: Random Meteors 编写如下脚本并保存为 RandomSpawn.lua 并放在工程目录下。 Write the following script, save it as RandomSpawn.lua, and place it in the project directory. Behavior() Property = { prefab = { type = "object", value = nil } } local RandomSpawn = class("RandomSpawn") local GameObject = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject local PerlinNoise = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.PerlinNoise local Instantiate = CS.UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate local Vector3 = CS.UnityEngine.Vector3 local meteorAmount = 100 -- 生成的陨石数量 local fieldSize = 100 -- 生成陨石的场景大小 local noiseScale = 10 -- 噪点大小，调整以获得不同的效果 function RandomSpawn:OnStarted() for i = 1, meteorAmount do local x = math.random() * fieldSize local z = math.random() * fieldSize local y = PerlinNoise(x / noiseScale, z / noiseScale) * fieldSize local pos = Vector3(x, y, z) local newMeteor = Instantiate(self.prefab, pos, Quaternion.identity) newMeteor.name = "Meteor_" .. tostring(i) end end return RandomSpawn 给场景物体挂上 LuaBehaviorMono，行为脚本选择刚刚编写的 Lua 脚本，然后 Lua 引用属性中，关联上场景物体即可。 Attach LuaBehaviorMono to a scene object, choose the Lua script you just wrote as its behavior script, then link the scene object in the Lua reference property. 在场景内，随机生成了一系列的陨石。 A series of meteors are randomly spawned in the scene.

manual/mod/ed198a30066ef2ec.html.title: 02.7 祝昔的载具 Mod 开发总结 Vehicle Modding Notes by 祝昔 | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/ed198a30066ef2ec.html.keywords: 02.7 祝昔的载具 Mod 开发总结 Vehicle Modding Notes by 祝昔 作者：@情绪薫 Author: @情绪薫 PW 模组制作中可能遇到的问题 Problems you may run into when making mods for PW 首先模型获取途径 Where to Get Models 第一个Sketchfab - The best 3D viewer on the web，上面有着大量模型，包括付费以及免费模型 First, Sketchfab - The best 3D viewer on the web. It hosts a large number of models, both paid and free. 第二个游戏中的载具模型 (gamemodels3d.com),上面有WT，WOT，WOTB，AW的大量模型，并且大部分WT模型都包含内构，需要付费注册账号来下载模型 Second, 游戏中的载具模型 (gamemodels3d.com). It has a large number of models from WT, WOT, WOTB and AW, and most WT models include internal structure. You need a paid account to download the models. 第三个CGTrader - 3D Models for VR / AR and CG projects，上面有着大量付费模型 Third, CGTrader - 3D Models for VR / AR and CG projects. It has a large number of paid models. 第四个其他。 Fourth, other sources. 接下来分为制作模组中遇到的问题以及制作更好的模组遇到的问题两个方面 The rest is divided into two parts: problems encountered while making a mod and problems encountered while making a better mod. 制作模组中遇到的问题 Problems Encountered While Making a Mod 模型原点的确定 Determining the model origin 无炮塔坦歼 Turretless tank destroyers 模组制作了内构但游戏里不显示 The mod has internal structure but it does not show up in game 在编辑过程中突然看不到hitbox The hitbox suddenly disappears while editing 坦克在车库中起飞翻转 The tank takes off and flips over in the garage 炮弹击中后产生的贴图过大 The decal produced when a shell hits is too large 模组在游戏内不显示 The mod does not show up in game 制作更好的模组遇到的问题 Problems Encountered While Making a Better Mod 动画 Animation 实体履带 Solid tracks 不同方向炮塔不同俯仰角 Different elevation angles in different turret directions 如何给模组设置缩略图 How to set a thumbnail for a mod 如何设置爆反装甲 How to set up reactive armor 模组查看装甲时部分装甲透明 Some armor is transparent when viewing armor in a mod 去除内构模型颜色 Removing the colors from internal structure models 给模型起名字 Naming the model 多边形炮管变圆 Making a faceted gun barrel look round 多炮塔例子 A multi-turret example 配对节点和重力节点 Pairing nodes and gravity nodes 如何解决模组启动停止时的猛烈磕头 How to fix violent nose-diving when the mod starts and stops 一、在制作模组中遇到的问题 Part 1: Problems Encountered While Making a Mod 1. 模型原点的确定 Determining the Model Origin 在blender中，你需要对以下部件设置原点 In Blender you need to set the origin for the following parts. 炮塔turret,设置炮塔原点以确保炮塔绕轴进行水平转动。 Turret: set the turret origin so that the turret rotates horizontally around its axis. （先点击左侧工具栏中的移动然后勾选右上角的原点，父级，然后就可以将物体原点移动到你想要的地方，完成后记得取消勾选原点和父级） (First click Move in the left toolbar, then tick Origin and Parent in the top right. You can then move the object origin wherever you want. Remember to untick Origin and Parent when you are done.) 炮盾Gun，将设置炮盾原点以确保坦克炮管俯仰正常 Gun mantlet (Gun): set the mantlet origin so that the tank's gun barrel elevates and depresses correctly. 炮管Dym，设置炮管原点来确保炮弹发射位置正确 Gun barrel (Dym): set the barrel origin so that shells are fired from the correct position. 轮子UpperWheel以及Wheel，右键设置原点在质心体积来确保轮子绕轴旋转 Wheels (UpperWheel and Wheel): right-click and set the origin to center of mass (volume) so that the wheels rotate around their axis. 2. 无炮塔坦歼 Turretless Tank Destroyers 对于无炮塔坦歼如猎虎，在blender中按shift+a，创建一个空轴来作为其炮塔，按g来移动空轴原点。 For turretless tank destroyers such as the Jagdtiger, press shift+a in Blender to create an empty that acts as the turret, and press g to move the empty's origin. 3. 模组制作了内构但游戏里不显示 The Mod Has Internal Structure but It Does Not Show up in Game 查看是否勾选配置模块化信息 Check whether Is Module Ready is ticked. 4. 在编辑过程中突然看不到hitbox The Hitbox Suddenly Disappears While Editing 查看hitbox是否隐藏 Check whether the hitbox is hidden. 5. 坦克在车库中起飞翻转 The Tank Takes off and Flips over in the Garage 查看是否设置坦克质量 Check whether you have set the tank's mass. 6. 炮弹击中后产生的贴图过大 The Decal Produced When a Shell Hits Is Too Large 查看炮弹口径是否填写出错 Check whether the shell caliber has been entered incorrectly. 7. 模组在游戏内不显示 The Mod Does Not Show up in Game 查看是否有音效未填 Check whether any sound effect fields have been left empty. 二、如何制作更好的模组 Part 2: How to Make a Better Mod 1. 动画 Animation 举例某些坦克上有旋转的雷达 For example, some tanks have a rotating radar. 如图在合适的位置创建一个空轴来保证雷达绕此轴旋转，然后将雷达放入空轴中，将空轴移动到炮塔下 As shown in the pictures, create an empty at a suitable position so that the radar rotates around that axis, then put the radar inside the empty and move the empty under the turret. 接着在unity中将物体拖入左侧栏中，选中该物体的雷达部件，右侧选择animation，animation制作教程可参照下面的视频 Then in Unity, drag the object into the left panel, select the radar part of that object, and choose Animation on the right. For an animation tutorial, refer to the video below. https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1zR4y1G7rt/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=8d9c532ad7fc3b92734fdeaf32c1ee66 制作完后需要将animator勾选（没有则需要在下方add component选择animator） When you are done you need to tick Animator (if there is none, use Add Component at the bottom to add an Animator). 最后模型上好贴图并设置碰撞体积放入collision文件夹中保存即可。 Finally, apply the textures to the model, set up the collision volumes, place them in the collision folder and save. 2. 实体履带 Solid Tracks 将履带块模型分离出来后，右键设置原点在质心（体积），接着右键吸附-选中项-游标，将模型角度调整如下，然后ctrl+a应用旋转，保存即可 After separating out the track link model, right-click and set the origin to center of mass (volume). Then right-click Snap - Selection to Cursor, adjust the model angle as shown below, press ctrl+a to apply the rotation, and save. 注意，当你需要设置左右两侧履带模型时，左履带模型需在上图基础上顺时针转动180度后再应用旋转 Note: when you need to set up track models for both the left and right sides, the left track model has to be rotated 180 degrees clockwise from the state shown above before you apply the rotation. 3. 不同方向炮塔不同俯仰角 Different Elevation Angles in Different Turret Directions 大部分坦克在不同方向的俯仰角不同，可以在特殊的俯仰角位置中进行设置 Most tanks have different gun elevation limits depending on the direction. You can configure this in the special elevation angle section. 4. 如何给模组设置缩略图 How to Set a Thumbnail for a Mod 将你的图片放入编辑器后，右侧设置选择sprite和single，再点击下方的apply即可 After importing your image into the editor, choose Sprite and Single in the settings on the right, then click Apply at the bottom. 5. 如何设置爆反装甲 How to Set up Reactive Armor 将爆反在HitBox中设置为reactive armor同时在内构中将其设置为内部装甲（你也可建一个内部爆反的模型） Set the reactive armor to reactive armor in the HitBox, and set it as internal armor in the internal structure (you can also build a separate model for the internal reactive armor). 6. 模组查看装甲时部分装甲透明 Some Armor Is Transparent When Viewing Armor in a Mod 有时当你查看一些地方的装甲时，它不会是红绿黄三色之一，而是透明的，这代表着该处法线反了，你需要用按tab进入编辑模式后选中透明处装甲，按shift+n来将法线调正。也可通过这个视频来学习如何修复法线。https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xr4y187Fc/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=8d9c532ad7fc3b92734fdeaf32c1ee66 Sometimes when you inspect the armor in a certain place it is not one of the three colors (red, green, yellow) but transparent. That means the normals there are flipped. Press tab to enter edit mode, select the transparent armor, and press shift+n to correct the normals. You can also watch this video to learn how to fix normals: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1xr4y187Fc/?share_source=copy_web&vd_source=8d9c532ad7fc3b92734fdeaf32c1ee66 7. 去除内构模型颜色 Removing the Colors from Internal Structure Models 有时当你查看内构时，有些内构模型仍然有贴图存在，这时你需要将内构模型拖入unity左侧栏中，点击reset来去除所有贴图，再对模型进行保存 Sometimes when you view the internal structure, some internal models still have textures on them. In that case, drag the internal model into Unity's left panel, click Reset to remove all textures, then save the model. 8. 给模型起名字 Naming the Model 9. 多边形炮管变圆 Making a Faceted Gun Barrel Look Round 有时你所拿到模型它的炮管和其他一些部位是多边形的，你可以在blender中点击模型，然后右键平滑着色来让它变圆 Sometimes the model you get has a faceted gun barrel and other faceted parts. In Blender you can click the model and then right-click Shade Smooth to make it look round. 10. 多炮塔例子 A Multi-Turret Example 其中SubTurret02是炮塔顶部的机枪，我用空轴来作为它的dym SubTurret02 is the machine gun on top of the turret; I used an empty as its dym. 而SubTurret01是共轴机枪，我将三个空轴叠加来作为共轴机枪，并套在Dym下，这使得它将同主炮一同移动，而你不需要设置其他多余的数据（如炮塔俯仰角，转速） SubTurret01 is the coaxial machine gun. I stacked three empties to serve as the coaxial machine gun and nested them under Dym, which makes it move together with the main gun, so you do not have to set any extra data (such as turret elevation angles or traverse speed). 11. 配对节点和重力节点 Pairing Nodes and Gravity Nodes 重力节点意味着履带在该点会受到重力影响而自然下垂 A gravity node means that the track will sag naturally at that point under the influence of gravity. 而配对节点则能够使得上下履带随负重轮一同上下运动 A pairing node makes the upper and lower track move up and down together with the road wheels. 如下图使用 Use them as shown below. 12. 如何解决模组启动停止时的猛烈磕头 How to Fix Violent Nose-Diving When the Mod Starts and Stops 一是将center of gravity摆放适中同时将其稍微下移（重心越高越不稳定），二是调整wheelcollider中右侧数据来调整摩擦 First, place the center of gravity in a moderate position and move it slightly downwards (the higher the center of gravity, the less stable the vehicle is). Second, adjust the values on the right side of the wheelcollider to tune friction. 详情请见此https://blog.csdn.net/weixin_43147385/article/details/124266796 See this article for details: https://blog.csdn.net/weixin_43147385/article/details/124266796

manual/mod/ef72909286442a91.html.title: 22.6.1 Lua 回调函数与 self Lua Callbacks and self | Panzer War Document
manual/mod/ef72909286442a91.html.keywords: 22.6.1 Lua 回调函数与 self Lua Callbacks and self 本文旨在为 Lua 编程新手提供一个关于回调函数与 self 的简要教程。我们将使用一个示例来说明如何在 Lua 中正确地使用回调函数和 self。 This article is a short tutorial on callback functions and self for newcomers to Lua programming. We will use an example to show how to correctly use callbacks and self in Lua. 示例代码 Example Code 以下是示例代码，用于演示如何在 Lua 中使用回调函数和 self： The following example code demonstrates how to use callback functions and self in Lua: Behavior() -- 定义属性 -- Define properties Propery = { keycode = { type = "string", -- 类型：字符串 Type: string value = "w" -- 键码值：W键 Key code value: W key } } -- 定义一个名为 InputTest 的类 -- Define a class called InputTest local InputTutorial = class("InputTutorial") function InputTutorial:ctor() self.actionName = "TestAPI" end -- 当 InputTest 开始时调用此函数 -- Call this function when InputTest starts function InputTutorial:OnStarted() -- 定义键按下的回调函数 -- Define the key press callback function self.OnKeyPerformedCb = function(context) self:OnKeyPerformed(context) end -- 定义键取消的回调函数 -- Define the key cancel callback function self.OnKeyCanceledCb = function(context) self:OnKeyCanceled(context) end -- 注册键输入事件 -- Register key input event InputAPI.RegisterKeyInput(self.actionName, self.keycode, self.OnKeyPerformedCb, self.OnKeyCanceledCb) end -- 当 InputTest 被销毁时调用此函数 -- Call this function when InputTest is destroyed function InputTutorial:OnDestroyed() print("On Destroyed") -- 注销键输入事件 -- Unregister key input event InputAPI.UnregisterKeyInput(self.actionName, self.keycode, self.OnKeyPerformedCb, self.OnKeyCanceledCb) end -- 键按下事件处理函数 -- Key press event handler function InputTutorial:OnKeyPerformed(context) print("on key pressed") -- 输出“按键按下” end -- 键取消事件处理函数 -- Key cancel event handler function InputTutorial:OnKeyCanceled(context) print("on key canceled") -- 输出“按键取消” end -- 返回 InputTest 类 -- Return InputTest class return InputTutorial 关键概念 Key Concepts 回调函数 Callback Functions 在这个示例中，我们使用了两个回调函数：self.OnKeyPerformedCb 和 self.OnKeyCanceledCb。这两个函数将作为参数传递给 InputAPI.RegisterKeyInput 函数，以便在某个键被按下或取消时执行相应的操作。 In this example we use two callback functions: self.OnKeyPerformedCb and self.OnKeyCanceledCb. Both are passed as arguments to InputAPI.RegisterKeyInput, so that the corresponding action is performed when a key is pressed or canceled. self self 在这个示例中用于关联回调函数和 InputTutorial 表的实例。在函数 InputTutorial:OnStarted() 中，我们使用 self 来定义回调函数，并将它们存储在实例变量中。这样，在调用 InputTutorial:OnKeyPerformed(context) 和 InputTutorial:OnKeyCanceled(context) 时，这些函数可以访问和操作 InputTutorial 表的实例。 In this example, self is used to associate the callback functions with the instance of the InputTutorial table. Inside InputTutorial:OnStarted() we use self to define the callbacks and store them in instance variables. That way, when InputTutorial:OnKeyPerformed(context) and InputTutorial:OnKeyCanceled(context) are called, these functions can access and operate on the instance of the InputTutorial table. 优点 Advantages 将回调函数与实例关联起来有以下几点好处： Associating the callback functions with the instance has the following benefits: 可读性：这种写法明确表明了回调函数属于 InputTutorial 表的实例，使代码更加清晰和易于理解。 Readability: this style makes it explicit that the callbacks belong to the instance of the InputTutorial table, which makes the code clearer and easier to understand. 重用性：将回调函数存储在实例变量中意味着你可以在其他地方重用这些回调函数，而不需要再次创建匿名函数。 Reusability: storing the callbacks in instance variables means you can reuse them elsewhere instead of creating another anonymous function. 维护性：这种写法提高了代码的维护性，因为在需要修改回调函数行为时，你只需要修改 self.OnKeyPerformedCb 和 self.OnKeyCanceledCb 的定义。 Maintainability: this style improves maintainability, because when you need to change the behavior of a callback you only have to modify the definitions of self.OnKeyPerformedCb and self.OnKeyCanceledCb.

manual/mod/f4e040506f378c99.html.keywords: 02.8 樱花的坦克抛壳动画 Tank Shell Ejection Animation (by 樱花) 一、Blender内准备 Part 1: Preparation in Blender 1.我们需要在Blender中设置好抛壳装置的旋转位置(如果没有抛壳装置，忽略这一步)。以AGS为例，我们需要设置物体原点到旋转中心，如图所示： Step 1: In Blender, set up the rotation position of the shell ejection mechanism (skip this step if there is no shell ejection mechanism). Taking the AGS as an example, we need to move the object origin to the center of rotation, as shown below: 2.我们将弹壳放入炮塔内，设置为炮管或者炮塔的子级： Step 2: Place the shell casing inside the turret and make it a child of the gun barrel or of the turret: 注：如果抛壳装置旋转轴不是x,y,z轴，以T72A为例，可以设置一个空物体，旋转到和抛壳装置同一个角度，并将抛壳装置设置为空物体的子级，这样在unity里我们只需旋转空物体即可，如下图所示： Note: if the rotation axis of the shell ejection mechanism is not the x, y or z axis — the T72A for example — you can create an empty object, rotate it to the same angle as the shell ejection mechanism, and make the mechanism a child of that empty object. Then in Unity you only need to rotate the empty object, as shown below: 二、unity内制作 Part 2: Authoring in Unity 1.首先打开unity的animation组件 Step 1: First open Unity's animation component. 2.选定需要制作动画的模型后，点击create创建动画 Step 2: After selecting the model you want to animate, click Create to create the animation. 3.设置你的动画文件名称后，点击保存 Step 3: Enter a name for your animation file, then click Save. 4.点击Add Property，可以在Transform中创建位置，旋转，大小三种变换，我们这里选择位置Position，如果需要动画过程中旋转，也可以添加Rotation。 Step 4: Click Add Property. Under Transform you can create three kinds of transformation — position, rotation and scale. Here we choose Position; if you also need rotation during the animation, you can add Rotation as well. 5.动画的制作可以参考如下链接中的视频： Step 5: For making the animation itself, refer to the video at the following link: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV17t4y1F7CZ/?spm_id_from=333.788&vd_source=5f5f291242e9ace2af6f7105ccc768bf 在动画制作过程中，我们可以点击下方的curves，调整动画曲线 While creating the animation, you can click Curves at the bottom to adjust the animation curves. 注：对于旋转轴不是x,y,z的模型，我们需要将坐标系调整到局部坐标下来制作动画，如下图所示： Note: for models whose rotation axis is not x, y or z, we need to switch the coordinate system to Local when creating the animation, as shown below: 同时需要调整旋转为四元数旋转模式(需要在没有制作动画之前设置，否则动画过程不会生效，需要重新制作)： You also need to switch rotation to quaternion rotation mode (this has to be set before you create the animation, otherwise it will not take effect during the animation and you will have to redo it): 三、组件设置 Part 3: Component Setup 增加Animation组件，如下设置： Step 1: Add an Animation component and configure it as shown below: 点击制作的动画，进入debug模式，勾选Legacy后，返回Normal模式： Step 2: Select the animation you created, switch to Debug mode, tick Legacy, then switch back to Normal mode: 保证wrap mode模式为default Make sure Wrap Mode is set to Default. 3.挂载Lua脚本组件： Step 3: Attach the Lua script component: lua代码如下： The Lua code is as follows: local PlayAnimationComponent = class("PlayAnimationComponent") Behavior() Property = { } function PlayAnimationComponent:OnStarted() local animation = self.script:GetNativeComponent("Animation") local ret, vehicle = self.script:TryGetTankInitSystem() if ret then VehicleAPI.RegisterVehicleLoadedEvent(vehicle, function() VehicleAPI.RegisterBulletFiredEvent(vehicle, 0, function() local isPlayed = animation:Play() end) end) end end return PlayAnimationComponent 至此动画制作完成。 The animation is now complete.

Track Tutorial 履带编辑器 Dedicated Equipment 专用配件 You can find procedural track at the start. 你可以一开始在列表中找到程序化履带 Attention 注意事项 Collision Setup 设置碰撞 Configure objects with collision in their slots to ensure the vehicle can move properly. Different types of colliders can affect the vehicle's physics in various ways. 在其插槽上配置带有碰撞的物体，以确保载具能够正常移动。不同类型的碰撞体会对载具的物理效果产生不同的影响。 Pick Editable Poly 选择可编辑多边形 Enable its collider 启用他的碰撞 Adjust center of gravity 调整重心 When creating your custom tank, adjusting the center of gravity is an important step to ensure your tank handles well. A higher center of gravity can cause the tank to tip over easily when turning or driving on uneven terrain, making it hard to control. By lowering the center of gravity or positioning it correctly, you can make your tank more stable and easier to handle, even in tough conditions. Make sure to experiment with different settings to find the perfect balance for your design! 在创建您自定义坦克时，调整重心是确保坦克良好操控的关键步骤。重心过高会导致坦克在转弯或行驶不平坦地形时容易倾翻，难以控制。通过降低重心或正确定位，可以使您的坦克更加稳定，即使在复杂环境中也能轻松驾驭。请尝试不同的设置，以找到适合您设计的最佳平衡！

manual/workshop/5d500c46cd72aa96.html.title: 2. GLB Import 工坊 (GLB 格式）模型规范 | Panzer War Document
manual/workshop/5d500c46cd72aa96.html.keywords: 2. GLB Import 工坊 (GLB 格式）模型规范 The tutorial process uses Blender modeling software, and the steps can be referred to for other modeling software as well. Blender can be downloaded for free on Steam. 教程使用的流程均为 Blender 建模软件的流程，其他建模软件也可以参考此教程的一些规范， Blender 可在 Steam 上免费下载。 Prepare Visual Model 准备外观模型 If using Blender, please refer to the following documentation. For the PBR workflow, follow the PBR rules outlined in the documentation to create the following textures: 1. Base Color, 2. Metallic and Roughness, 3. Baked Ambient Occlusion, and 4. Normal Map. Other textures mentioned in the documentation are not required. You can use Substance Painter to create the necessary textures. If not following the PBR workflow, you need to create 1. Base Color (mandatory) and 2. Normal Map (optional). However, the model will not achieve realistic physical reflections. 若使用 Blender，则可以参考下面的文档。 制作 PBR 流程，则需按文档中的 PBR 规则，制作 1. 基础色，2. 金属度与粗糙度，3. 烘焙的环境光遮蔽与 4. 法线贴图。 其他文档中提及的贴图无需制作。可使用 Substance Painter 制作相应的贴图。 若不按 PBR 流程制作，则需要制作 1. 基础色 （必选） 2. 法线贴图 （可选）。但是模型无法获得真实的物理反光效果。 glTF 2.0 - Blender 4.3 Manual （中文用户点击此链接打开文档：https://docs.blender.org/manual/zh-hans/4.3/addons/import_export/scene_gltf2.html） Preview the effect of the completed model in Blender. 制作完成后的模型在 Blender 中的效果预览。 Additionally, you need to use LOD tools to create corresponding low-polygon models for displaying objects at a distance, reducing rendering performance pressure. You can choose to use the InstaLOD Blender plugin to automatically create LODs: 此外，你需要使用 LOD 工具，制作对应的低多边形的模型，用于物体在远处的显示，以降低渲染性能压力。 Follow the InstaLOD for Blender official installation guide to sign in to License Management, then download the latest plugin and the InstaLOD Pipeline from Your Files. 可以选择使用 InstaLOD 的 Blender 插件自动制作 LOD。请按照 InstaLOD for Blender 官方安装文档登录 License Management，并从 Your Files 下载最新插件和 InstaLOD Pipeline。 Or use InstaLOD Studio: follow the InstaLOD Studio official installation guide to download and install the standalone version. 或者按照 InstaLOD Studio 官方安装文档下载并安装独立版。 If you do not use InstaLOD, you can also create low-polygon LODs manually with Blender's built-in Decimate Modifier. 不使用 InstaLOD 时，也可以使用 Blender 内置的 Decimate Modifier手动制作低面数 LOD。 Child-Parent 父子关系 Rule 放置规则 Create four empty objects (Shift + A and select Empty - Plain Axes) and name them Visual, Collider, HitBox, and Module respectively. Note that the size and spelling must be exactly the same. Visual is used for placing the appearance model and LOD, Collider is used for placing non-concave collision models, HitBox is used for placing external armor, and Module is used for placing internal armor. 创建四个空物体 （Shift + A 选择 Empty - Plain Axes），并分别命名为 Visual，Collider，HitBox 与 Module。 注意，大小与拼写需要保持完全一致。 Visual 用于放置外观模型与LOD，Collider 用于摆放非凹的碰撞模型，HitBox 用于放置外部装甲，Module 用于放置内部装甲。 Completed State 制作完成后状态 After completing the various models, place them according to the rules in section 2.1. The specifications for creating damage models and internal structure models will be introduced in sections 3 and 4. (If this module is an object that can be hit by shells, these two models must be created.) The Collider collision model only needs to be created when making the vehicle hull model. 在制作完成各类模型后，按照 2.1 的规则放置各类模型。 伤害模型与内构模型的制作规范会在第 3，4 节中介绍。 （若此模块是可被炮弹击中的物体，则必须制作这两个模型） Collider 碰撞模型只有制作车体模型时候才需要制作。 LOD 特殊处理 Make the LOD models child objects of the unoptimized model and name them OriginalObjectName_LODNumber (starting from 1, up to a maximum of 3 LOD levels). **The name of the unoptimized original model must end with LOD0. ** 将 LOD 模型作为未优化模型的子物体，并命名为 原始物体名称_LOD序号 （序号从1 开始，至多可以制作3层 LOD)。未优化的原始模型的名称必须以 LOD0 结尾。 LOD 模型 HitBox 外部装甲 Reduced-polygon versions of the visual model. Models with different armor thicknesses need to be separated and then set their armor type and armor thickness according to the naming conventions in section 5. 外观模型的减面版本的模型。 不同装甲厚度的模型需要分离开，然后通过第5节的命名规范设置其装甲类型，装甲厚度。 Internal Module 内构模型 Lower-polygon internal module models are used for post-penetration shell damage. Then, set their type, armor thickness, and health according to the naming conventions in section 5. 较低面数的内部模块模型，用于炮弹后效伤害。 然后通过第5节的命名规范设置其类型，装甲厚度与血量。 Collider 碰撞模型 A collision model only needs to be created for the vehicle hull model. 只有制作给车体的模型，才需要制作碰撞模型。 Naming 命名规范 2.12 HitBox Naming 伤害模型命名规范 Export 导出 Select the model you want to export, then click on glTF 2.0, choose the .glb format, check Selected Objects, and click Export. 选中你要导出的模型，然后点击 glTF 2.0，格式选择 .glb ，勾上 Selected Object，然后点击 Export。 Using Model 使用模型 Use Model Importer 使用模型导入工具 Windows Platform 电脑平台 Android Platform 安卓平台 Click on the glb format file and select Panzer War: Definitive Edition as the opening application. Enter the Tank Workshop, choose Model Import, and enter your glb file name (including the file extension). 点击 glb 格式文件，打开方式选择 装甲纷争：决定版。进入坦克工坊，选择 模型导入，输入你的 glb 文件名 （带后缀）

manual/workshop/ad317e8a749c8ea2.html.title: 3. Gun Tutorial 火炮教程 | Panzer War Document
manual/workshop/ad317e8a749c8ea2.html.keywords: 3. Gun Tutorial 火炮教程 Custom Reload Type 自定义装填类型 Simple 简单 Traditional single-shot shells only require setting the reload time. 传统的单发炮弹，只需要设置装填时间。 Advanced 高级 For multi-shot magazine guns, you need to set the small reload time, the large reload time, and the magazine size. 多发弹夹炮，需要设置小装填，大装填，以及弹夹长度。 If the magazine size is too large, you can hide the icon to avoid a cluttered UI. 如果弹夹长度过大，可以隐藏图标，以避免 UI 过于拥挤。 Drum 弹鼓 Invented by the Italians, the drum mechanism is an optimized type of magazine gun that allows you to fire while loading backup rounds. You need to set the reload time for each backup round and the minimum firing interval of the drum. 由意大利发明的弹鼓机制，弹夹炮的优化类型，可以一边装载备发弹，一边开火。需要设置每个备发弹的装填时间，以及弹鼓的最小射击间隔。 Import Default Bullet 导入现有炮弹 You can modify the specific parameters of the default shells by importing the default shells. 你可以通过导入默认炮弹的方式，以修改默认的炮弹的具体参数。 If you wish to fully customize your shells, you can also directly add different types of shells using the add button above. 如果你希望完全自定义你的炮弹，也可以直接通过上方的添加按钮，添加不同类型的炮弹。 The shell data will display the basic parameters of the shell, along with some specialized parameters in modular mode. 在炮弹数据中会显示炮弹的基本参数，与模块模式中的一些专用参数。 In the debugging information of the shell, you can see the calculated data. If you modify the parameters of the shell, you need to click the recalculate button. 在炮弹的调试信息中，你可以看到计算后的相关数据。若修改了炮弹的参数，需要点击重新计算按钮。 Demarre Formula 德马尔公式 In our game, the penetration mechanics are based on the De Marre formula, which is used to estimate the penetration of a shell against armor. Here is an explanation of the formula and its parameters. 在我们的游戏中，穿甲弹机制基于德马尔公式，用于估算穿甲弹对装甲的穿透能力。以下是公式及其参数的解释。 $ \text{Penetration 穿深} = \left( \frac{m \cdot v_{\text{rel}}^2}{d^3 \cdot D_{\text{term}}} \right)^{\frac{1}{C_{\text{armor}}}} \cdot d \cdot K_{\text{nap}} \cdot 100 $ $ m $ is the shell mass (kg) 是炮弹的质量 （千克）； $ v_{\text{rel}} $ is the shell velocity component in the direction of the plate, calculated as: 是炮弹命中装甲板的速度，如下计算： $ v_{\text{rel}} = v_d \cdot \cos(\theta \cdot 0.85 \cdot C_{\text{angle}}) $ $ v_d = v_0 \left( 1 - \frac{\lambda d}{v_0} \right) $ where $ C_{\text{angle}} $ is the penetration vs angle coefficient, $ \lambda $ is the drag, and $ v_0 $ is the initial velocity; 其中 $ C_{\text{angle}} $ 是斜穿系数，$ \lambda $ 是阻力，$ v_0 $ 是炮弹初速度； $ d $ is the shell diameter (m) 是炮弹直径 （单位米）； $ D_{\text{term}} $ is the De Marre term, calculated as: 是德马尔项，计算如下： $ D_{\text{term}} = \left( D_{\text{const}} \right)^2 \cdot d^{-0.1} $ where $ D_{\text{const}} $ is the De Marre constant; 其中 $ D_{\text{const}} $ 是德马尔常数； $ C_{\text{armor}} $ is the armor material coefficient 是命中装甲板的材料系数； $ K_{\text{nap}} $ is the adjustment factor based on the TNT ratio, calculated as follows: 是基于 TNT 比例的调整系数，计算如下： $ K_{\text{nap}} = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 0.65 \ 1 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 0.65 \right) \cdot (0.93 - 1)}{1.6 - 0.65} & \text{if } 0.65 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 1.6 \ 0.93 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 1.6 \right) \cdot (0.9 - 0.93)}{2 - 1.6} & \text{if } 1.6 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 2 \ 0.9 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 2 \right) \cdot (0.85 - 0.9)}{3 - 2} & \text{if } 2 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 3 \ 0.85 + \frac{\left(\frac{\text{TNT}}{m} - 3 \right) \cdot (0.75 - 0.85)}{4 - 3} & \text{if } 3 \leq \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} < 4 \ 0.75 & \text{if } \frac{\text{TNT}}{m} \geq 4 \end{cases} $ This formula combines all the terms to calculate the penetration of the shell against armor, taking into account the mass, velocity, diameter, material properties, impact angle, and explosive charge of the shell. 该公式结合所有参数来计算炮弹对装甲的穿透力，考虑了炮弹的质量、速度、直径、材料特性、入射角度和装药量。
